name: detail-D-wall_roof-INT_2X6_BRG_HALF-ROOF
notes: • Roof: TJI 230 at 24" o.c., milled LSL ridge plate. LSTA18, H8 primary.
• Bay: 5" ccSPF on deck, R-30C batt. Foam is the air and vapour barrier.
• Deck: 19/32" CDX, 40/20, oversailing the rafter ends to the girt face.
• Butyl membrane 240 F, full field + eave strip-in. 24 ga Image II, nail flange.
• Partition stops 3/4" under rafters; SDPW19600 screw per crossing.
• Foam first lift 1-1/2" min; lap the ridge closure and bevel faces in one pass.
